raw:
I'm running 100 experiments: 10 diverse parent cells with 10 edits each. The parents span all-conv, all-skip, all-pool, sparse and mixed cells. Within each parent the edits hit different edges and ops. Because the same edit lands on several different parents, differences in its effect across parents can expose conditions.

I haven't run any of these yet, so no results or hypotheses exist.
